text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... It's far... too far...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, not that... What's too far is the
distance
between me and McQueen.
choice_data_list: Was the distance too long for you, Ryan?
Was the distance too long for you, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I thought I closed the gap, but I'm still
not there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen is formidable, after all—even
more so
at 3,000 meters, her specialty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It appears that you've retained your
pride. Well
done, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen... I lost. The difference in our

long-distance potential really is a world
apart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's to be expected. I've always
kept my
focus on long distances, ever
since I was a young
child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would never give in easily. And there is
a great
difference in the time I've spent
honing my skills.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So you've spent way more time at it than
I have...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Trainer, I don't think I lost due to
a lack of
talent at long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm behind in terms of distance, sure, but
the
bigger difference is the number of
years we've
spent training for this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen has always been focused on
winning.
And it's only recently that I've
really begun to try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That difference in time spent... That's
what sets us
apart now. I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen... You could say she's a
lifelong
stayer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When comparing their experiences,
Mejiro Ryan
is undeniably green.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems that I still have the advantage in
terms of
stability. But the next time
around...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I hope to see your true resolve,
something
spectacular in the final
furlong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You got it! I promise you, McQueen!
You'll see it
next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh... So the next big race is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen! You'll be racing me
again there,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, who knows? I can't make any
promises.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Mejiro Ryan loses to Mejiro
McQueen,
there's no look of inferiority
in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But there's still a long road ahead of
her—toward
the Arima Kinen, where
many more strong
opponents await.
